title.narrative: Support to the Regional School of Public Administration (ReSPA)

description.narrative: Contract related to: Support to the Regional School of Public Administration (ReSPA) - The action aims to support public administration reforms and building institutional quality in the Western Balkans in line with the Principles of Public Administration and the European integration process. In this regard, the action will directly and significantly contribute to the Western Balkans¿ progress toward EU accession preparation. ReSPA and its Members will seek to achieve these goals, through focusing the proposed action/support in the following areas: Public Administration Reform (PAR); European integration process and accession negotiations as well as quality management (QM).
